operation_details.item: The user uses cost-plus pricing for one product line.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good afternoon. I'm reviewing your pricing strategy notes for the upcoming sales kickoff. Could you clarify how you've structured pricing across your offerings?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Sure. I use value-based pricing for the platform.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense for the platform. What about the more affordable option?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: For that, I use competitor-based pricing for the entry tier.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Thanks. And how do you keep all of this consistent across your team?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pricing approaches are documented in the pricing guide.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's helpful. I also noticed you have a separate product line with a different margin structure. How is that priced?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use cost-plus pricing for one product line.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. So to summarize, you have value-based on the platform, competitor-based on entry, cost-plus on one line, and documented in the guide. That should help us prepare the presentation.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I'll send over the latest guide after we wrap up.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Perfect. Let me know if you need any help aligning the cost-plus line's messaging with the overall value narrative.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Will do. I'll reach out if that comes up.
